items.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.

items.title: Schrödinger (SDGR) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift As Analysts Raise Software Growth Views
items.summary: Schrödinger’s updated framework now points to a fair value move from US$31.14 to US$33.57 per share, which feeds into a higher implied pricing range for the stock. Recent analyst commentary links these shifts to stronger software contract metrics, raised 2026 guidance and a more constructive view on Schrödinger’s role in AI driven discovery, while still flagging higher expectations after the share price move. Read on to see how these changing assumptions shape the evolving analyst narrative...

items.title: How Much of Your Portfolio Should Be in Bitcoin After a 50% Drop?
items.summary: Bitcoin has shed more than half its value, ETF money is walking out the door, and Wall Street's biggest names set their allocation limits before the crash. Does a rebalance now make you smart or just early?
